text:
alex: Heads-up: noticed a ~30% drop in token_latency.per_route.* signals since 2026-03-17 03:00 UTC. Dashboards show spikes in statsd drops from the kv-emitter. Anyone else seeing this?

infra-bot: alert: statsd_emitter_dropped_packets increased from 2.1/min to 45/min on infra-prod-1 (last 60m)

dana: I see runtime-side counters too — kernel-selection logs show flush errors around the same time. We merged a batching heuristic tweak yesterday (PR #4123). Could be related.

monica: Confirmed on the observability side. OTLP exporter traces show intermittent 503s from the kvcache exporter to the metrics aggregator starting ~03:05 UTC. Correlated with higher payload sizes and bursty continuous-batching for long seqs.

sasha: The emitter has a backpressure knob that we lowered last week to reduce tail latency. Under sudden burst + bigger payloads that probably triggered drops.

jamal: FWIW the kernel-selection change in #4123 added per-token metadata tags (route, model, kernel_hint) which increased stats payload ~18%. Combined with the lowered buffer -> backpressure + UDP fragmentation = drops.

monica: Proposed plan: 1) short mitigation (canary) to compact/remove non-critical tags at emitter; 2) run a backfill job to replay missing metrics from OTLP archives into Prometheus; 3) follow-up hardening for exporter retries/backpressure metrics.

alex: Can we avoid a rollback? Quick patch to compact tags (route->r, model->m) is low-risk and keeps telemetry useful. I can open that patch.

sasha: I'll push compact-tags patch (#4130) to canary now and nudge buffer +2x as a temporary config change. Also will enable verbose emitter debug for 30m to validate. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metrics-drop

infra-bot: deploy: canary started for eng-runtime/emitter:sha:87abcf -> prod-eng1 (target route=chat-v1) at 1798502800

jamal: Backfill job scheduled: metrics-backfill-2026-03-17-1798503000. Worker pool=8, read OTLP archives from s3://metrics-archive/2026-03-17/, replay into prom-pushgateway, add label _backfilled=true. ETA ~2h. I'll post job logs to the incident thread.

monica: After backfill we should run a token-latency diff between live and backfilled metrics and surface any mismatches to the per-route KPIs dashboard. Also adding alerting for statsd_emitter_dropped_packets > 10/min. Created follow-up ticket #4152 for MTU/fragmentation handling and exporter retry improvements.

alex: Thanks — watching the canary and the backfill. Will update if we see residual drops.

monica: quick note: when replaying, please drop tag 'kernel_hint' from per-token metrics (we don't need it in prom) to keep cardinality low.

jamal: noted, backfill job configured to drop kernel_hint. Starting replay in 2m. Job link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/metrics-backfill-1798503000

alex: :thumbsup:
